derivation:
by
  refine ⟨(LieModuleHom.codRestrict N ⟨ψ, fun {x m} ↦ hψlie x m⟩ hψmem).ker, ?_⟩
  exact LieSubmodule.isCompl_toSubmodule.mp (LinearMap.isCompl_of_proj fun n ↦ Subtype.ext (hψid n n.2))
explanation: Instantiate the projection theorem with ψ corestricted to N. Equivariance packages this map as a Lie module homomorphism; its kernel is a Lie submodule, and complementarity transfers from underlying submodules.
